description.zh: 应用唯一标识，可以包含小写字母、数字，长度为6个字符。
description.en: The unique identifier of the application. The value can contain lowercase letters and digits and is 6 characters in length.

description.zh: 房间ID，由字母、数字、下划线（_）和小数点（.）组成，最大长度36个字符。
description.en: The room ID. The value can contain letters, digits, underscores (_), and periods (.), with a maximum length of 36 characters.
